dataset.name: ETTh1
dataset.split_source: TFB paper Table 5: 8640/2880/2880 hourly rows; first 20 months (30-day benchmark months)

evaluation.metric_scale: StandardScaler fitted on training rows [0,8640) only

protocol_notes: All horizons are trained independently. Smoke tests use one epoch and seed 2024 and never enter formal summaries.
All models use seq_len=96 as requested; this overrides longer seq_len in some upstream ETTh1 scripts.
Training drop_last=True follows the upstream multivariate adapter. Validation and test include all windows.
Validation uses training-tail context; test uses earlier observations only, with no refitting on validation or test.

Unchanged TFB forecast_fit, model classes, Adam, early stopping and batch_forecast are reused. Instrumentation subclass weights validation by element count, orders validation windows and saves checkpoints and logs.
Full deterministic policy follows TFB, additionally torch deterministic algorithms are required and TF32 is disabled; AMP is disabled.
Time marks are passed unchanged by the adapter, including calendar covariate tokens for iTransformer.
PatchTST h96 upstream n_headers=2 is an unused typo; actual n_heads=8 is preserved explicitly.
DLinear h720 upstream omits lr; inherited adapter default 0.0001 is retained.
No test-based hyperparameter search. Epoch and patience budgets are TFB TransformerAdapter defaults.

96.source: vendor/TFB/scripts/multivariate_forecast/ETTh1_script/PatchTST.sh line 1; upstream n_headers typo leaves n_heads=8
